units.name: monk
units.prompt: Create a 3x3 animation sprite sheet, same flat storybook ink watercolor style as reference: warm dark brown outlines, muted blocks, two shadow tones, paper grain, no 3D. cute human monk in cream robe with blue gold mantle, short brown hair, holding a golden sun staff. Nine full-body poses in EXACT equal cells with generous gutters and all appendages within cell; fixed scale and ground baseline. All face RIGHT. Row1 idle, walk stride one, passing step. Row2 opposite stride, passing step two, raising staff with gold light. Row3 shooting a small golden holy orb, recovery, recoiling hit. For winged creatures the four movement poses are wings raised, diagonal up, horizontal, down in flight; ghost moves with four flowing wispy silhouettes; mounted knight keeps rider mounted in all poses. Transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, labels, numbers, text, floor or cast shadows. Preserve identical costume and anatomy in every frame. Square canvas.
